pricing.name: Discord server setup
pricing.summary: A clean, organized server built around your community.
pricing.points:
Categories, channels and roles with the right permissions
Welcome, rules and verification
Up to 3 bots set up (moderation, roles, leveling or music)
Basic AutoMod and anti-spam

pricing.name: Mod team setup & training
pricing.summary: Give your mods the tools and the playbook.
pricing.points:
AutoMod rules, word filters and raid protection
Mod roles, private mod channels and a log channel
A short mod handbook: when to warn, mute, ban or escalate
Optional 1-hour walkthrough with your mods

pricing.name: Monthly server care
pricing.summary: Keep things running while you focus on your community.
pricing.points:
Bot updates and replacements when they break
Channel and role changes as you grow
A monthly permissions check
Event and seasonal setups

pricing.name: One-page website
pricing.summary: A single, polished page that sends people where you want them.
pricing.points:
Custom design that fits your brand
Works on phones, fast to load
Links, socials, a contact or signup form
Hosting setup and connecting your domain
2 rounds of changes

pricing.name: Multi-page website
pricing.summary: A full site with room to grow, like 757animeclub.com.
pricing.points:
Up to 5 pages, custom design
Extras like events, galleries, a shop link or a members area
An easy way to update your own content (quoted per feature)
Hosting, domain and search basics
3 rounds of changes

pricing.name: Monthly site care
pricing.summary: Updates and fixes without the headache.
pricing.points:
Small text and photo updates
Fixes if anything breaks
Hosting and domain checks
Help with questions as they come up
